title: Emotion-Network Density in Major Depressive Disorder
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited range of positive emotion words; - Sample may not generalize to at-risk or recovered individuals; - Recruitment site effects may have influenced results.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated, but supplementary materials may be available via the authors or OSF. The network estimation method used multilevel models, but specific R packages for network estimation are not reported.
